hotel_2star_room_2p.sourceTitle: Best 2-Star Hotels in Sydney (Prices & Reviews) | Trip.com
hotel_2star_room_2p.evidenceText: Trip.com’s Sydney 2-star page states an average price of AZN 231 on weekdays and AZN 293 on weekends (Friday–Saturday). The page also says featured prices were based on Trip.com for July 2–8. It does not state 2 adults and 1 room or whether taxes and fees are included.
hotel_2star_room_2p.referencePeriod: Trip.com page crawled 3 weeks before retrieval; featured prices July 2–8 2026 and weekday/weekend averages
hotel_2star_room_2p.searchQuery: site:trip.com/hotels/star2/city Sydney Australia 2-star hotels 2 adults 1 room average nightly price taxes fees
hotel_2star_room_2p.reason: A city/class weekday and weekend average was returned, but the currency is a localized AZN display unrelated to Sydney, the statistic is not an unqualified current nightly average, and occupancy and tax/fee treatment are absent; strict acceptance fails.
